mechanism_narrative: A sustained 3-month decline in the federal funds rate signals an easing monetary cycle that compresses discount rates applied to equity cash flows, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: Walk-forward Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 2-year rolling window, or 20-day forward returns in easing periods are not significantly higher than baseline (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the unemployment rate above 6.5% over three months signals weakening consumer demand and earnings pressure, driving negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods when UNRATE > 6.5% (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) over two consecutive quarters signals deteriorating demand, which reduces corporate earnings and equity valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 declines for two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of two consecutive quarterly declines in GDPC1 (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the industrial production index (INDPRO) above 3% over six months signals robust manufacturing activity and earnings growth, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO rises above 3% over six months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of INDPRO > 3% for six months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the federal funds rate and decline in consumer price inflation (CPIAUCSL) over three months signals a disinflationary tightening cycle, which reduces discount rates and supports equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises and CPIAUCSL falls over three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS rise and CPIAUCSL decline over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous rise in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) and decline in average weekly hours worked (HOUST) over three months signals deteriorating labor market conditions and earnings pressure, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: UNRATE rises and HOUST falls over three months
failure_condition: 20-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of UNRATE rise and HOUST decline over three months (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in real personal consumption expenditures (GDPC1) above 4% over two consecutive quarters signals robust demand growth, which boosts earnings and equity valuations, producing positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: GDPC1 rises above 4% over two consecutive quarters
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly higher than baseline during periods of GDPC1 > 4% for two consecutive quarters (t-test p > 0.05).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained rise in the federal funds rate above 4.5% over six months signals a restrictive monetary policy regime, which increases discount rates and pressures valuations, producing negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
candidate_trigger: FEDFUNDS rises above 4.5% over six months
failure_condition: 60-day forward returns are not significantly lower than baseline during periods of FEDFUNDS > 4.5% for six months (t-test p > 0.05).
